description: GSC Bucket System Design: deploy lifecycle through GSC buckets (GSS_PENDING → GSC_READY → DEPLOYING → CLOUDFLARE_WAIT → GSC_FULL_DEPLOY). Bucket transitions via verify_deploy / verify_gsc_discover / wait_for_quota_available, Cloudflare Queue edge retry, user email notification on full deploy. See docs/gsc/gsc_bucket_design.md.
steps: Design: bucket states GSS_PENDING → GSC_READY → DEPLOYING → CLOUDFLARE_WAIT → GSC_FULL_DEPLOY (design doc)
Design: deploy-time buckets registration + edge queue (Cloudflare Queue) design
Design: deploy_discovery_requeue — sitemap + Indexing API + durable queue, GSS_PENDING → GSC_READY transition
Design: verify_deploy — GSC_READY → DEPLOYING transition (sites.get deployed=True)
Design: verify_gsc_discover — DEPLOYING → CLOUDFLARE_WAIT transition (sites.get + sitemaps.get + INDEX_GSC_READY)
Design: wait_for_quota_available — CLOUDFLARE_WAIT → GSC_DISCOVER_VERIFY (quota + discovery check)
Design: GSC_FULL_DEPLOY_NOTIFY — user email on full deploy (timeline + statuses + unauthenticated check-ins)

description: Astro + Cloudflare 2026 Best Practices: wrangler.jsonc (Workers, assets.directory, not_found_handling), Cache Provider API (cacheCloudflare → Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control), _headers immutable для _astro/*, imageService cloudflare-binding, img width/height/loading=lazy (CLS), _redirects. Static audit + config generation. See docs/cloudflare-astro-2026.md.
steps: wrangler.jsonc: assets.directory=./dist, compatibility_date, not_found_handling=404-page (Workers — рекомендованный путь 2026)
cache: cacheCloudflare() provider → Cloudflare-CDN-Cache-Control + Cache-Tag; public/_headers /_astro/* immutable
images: imageService cloudflare-binding (дефолт @astrojs/cloudflare@14); img width/height против CLS + loading=lazy
redirects: public/_redirects или configured redirects в astro.config
best_practices: полный аудит → docs/reports/f014-astro-cf-*.md (overall PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED)
Auto Minify выключить при hydration mismatch (troubleshooting)
